column1: Correction log for agent work in this repository. Append one line per correction round (tab-separated): ISO date |
what went wrong | correction + where it is encoded.

column2: subagents working in git worktrees edited the main checkout through relative paths (twice), caught and reverted
column3: give each worktree agent its absolute path and tell it every edit path must be absolute (.claude/session-summary.md gotcha)

column2: ran the app for UI checks under dbus-run-session with the real XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: the private bus started its own xdg-document-portal, which took over /run/user/UID/doc and left `flatpak run` failing for the real session once it exited (fixed by restarting xdg-document-portal.service)
column3: give a private-bus harness its own XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, so its portals mount there (.claude/session-summary.md gotcha)

column2: harness runs of the app reached the host's system bus, and pressing Suspend in the power dock suspended the user's real PC twice
column3: the harness's run.sh points DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS at a socket that does not exist; power actions only against a fake logind on a private bus (.claude/session-summary.md harness note, harness README)

column2: posted the maintainer's decisions on #792 as an issue comment, then a follow-up question changed one of them; another agent implemented the stale comment and the merge queue merged it (#795), which had to be replaced (#802)
column3: post a decision comment only once every follow-up question is answered, and edit it when one changes it (.claude/session-summary.md)

column2: the stacked PR #841 still targeted `feat/833-install-external-importers` when its base #840 merged, so merging #841 eight seconds later put its commits on a branch `main` had already taken; #834 looked done but was not on `main` and had to be re-landed (#845)
column3: retarget each stacked PR to `main` and let its checks finish before merging it, as `merge-stack.sh` does (.claude/session-summary.md)
